description_en: Modifies the configuration of a VPC firewall for a transit router. Prerequisites: Create a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) Enterprise Edition transit router, call CreateTrFirewallV2 to create a VPC firewall for the transit router, and obtain the FirewallId before calling this operation
description_zh: 修改TR防火墙配置。【前置依赖】CEN 企业版转发路由器 → CreateTrFirewallV2 创建 TR 防火墙 → 获取 FirewallId 后调用本 API
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-tr-firewall-v2-configuration --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-bcdf89d405ce4bd20000 --firewall-name vpc-firewall --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTrFirewallV2Configuration

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese
- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

- **zh**（默认）：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

> FirewallId and FirewallName are jointly required. If both are not provided, an ErrorParameters(400) error is returned. You can call DescribeTrFirewallsV2List to obtain the FirewallId
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

> FirewallId 与 FirewallName 联合必填，未同时提供返回 ErrorParameters(400)。FirewallId 可通过 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 获取
parameters.name: firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance name of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.
> FirewallId and FirewallName are jointly required. If both are not provided, an ErrorParameters(400) error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙实例名。
> FirewallId 与 FirewallName 联合必填，未同时提供返回 ErrorParameters(400)
parameters.name: firewall_name
